entities.name: Q54BD5 TRM13
observations: Exact sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed Dictyostelium discoideum tRNA:m(4)X modification enzyme TRM13 homolog; annotated EC 2.1.1.225.
Annotated as a tRNA 2′-O-methyltransferase acting at nucleotide 4 of tRNA(Pro), tRNA(Gly)(GCC), and tRNA(His).
Query sequence Pfam hits: zf-TRM13_CCCH (58–89), zf-U11-48K (137–161), and TRM13 (252–523).

entities.name: TRM13 tRNA 2′-O-methylation
observations: Transfers a methyl group from S-adenosyl-L-methionine to the 2′-hydroxyl of nucleotide 4 in tRNA; produces 2′-O-methylated tRNA, S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine, and H+. Rhea mappings include RHEA:32767, RHEA:43192, and RHEA:43196.
